# Synthetic fixtures

These three tiny archives are generated by `inspectionFixture` in
`internal/pvf/inspect_test.go`. They contain only a synthetic script, a short
text entry and three opaque bytes. `unsafe.bin` uses an unsafe directory name
to exercise export rejection. No game files are included.

To reproduce them without overwriting the checked-in files, set
`PVFCLI_GENERATE_FIXTURES` to an empty output directory and run:

```text
go test ./internal/pvf -run TestInspectionFormatsAndFixtures -count=1
```

Compare the generated bytes with this directory, then unset the variable.
